errors.text_span: SMoE begins near 2.1 and SimSMoE near 2.0
errors.evidence: The description reverses the starting points of the two models. The plot shows SimSMoE (magenta) starting at a high BPC value of approximately 2.18, while SMoE (black) starts at a lower value of approximately 1.7.
After 20,000 steps, the SMoE line stabilizes at a BPC value closer to 1.15-1.17, not 1.2. The value is approximately 1.2 right before the drop at 20,000 steps, but not during the stable phase.

errors.text_span: The magenta line (SimSMoE) consistently remains below the black line (SMoE) throughout the training process
errors.evidence: The magenta line (SimSMoE) starts above the black line (SMoE) at the beginning of the training process and crosses it shortly after. Therefore, it is not 'consistently' below the black line.
